card.title: IPad Pro 9.7 not displaying any image on the screen repair

source.title: IPad Pro 9.7 not displaying any image on the screen repair

claims.statement: iPad Pro 9.7 with no backlight usually has blown backlight filter FL1728 (often from connecting a screen with the battery attached); a smashed FPC connector can also blow it.

procedure: Replace FL1728 (and FPC connector if smashed).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
